data.narrative:
Perigee Aerospace is a Series D-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $56.64M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 4 private peers in the same sector and stage (Sierra Space at $8.0B, Apex Space at $2.3B, Varda Space Industries at $1.6B, and Skyryse at $1.1B), along with 5 public aerospace benchmarks (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) that trade at a median 25.3x price-to-sales multiple.

Two triangulation methods are applicable given available data. Stage-progression analysis applies a standard 1.5x step-up multiplier to the $57M raised proxy, yielding $85M. Peer-median analysis establishes a $1.9B implied valuation across the four same-sector comparables, with a range spanning $1.1B to $8.0B. The public-comp anchoring method cannot be applied absent disclosed revenue figures, typical for private companies at this stage. The peer median of $1.9B reflects meaningful dispersion: Apex Space and Varda Space (both Series D) imply $2.3B and $1.6B respectively, while the Series C outliers (Sierra Space and Skyryse) create a wide distribution.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $72M to $2.2B, with a median point of $1.0B. The wide range reflects tension between capital-raised benchmarks (favoring the lower bound) and sector peer multiples (favoring the upper-to-mid range). Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, technology differentiation relative to peers, and capital efficiency relative to Apex and Varda.
